_comment: Source of truth for the flatpak sanity check (.github/scripts/check-flatpak-remote.py) and the smoke test (.github/scripts/flatpak-smoke-test.py). 'name' is the GHCR registry path (matched against index/static Results[].Name) -- archs listed are required; missing ones fail the check, missing 'archs_planned' only warn. 'issue_repo' is the GitHub repo the smoke test files issues against; only present when it differs from 'name' (letters/tables/decks kept their original per-app registry paths after consolidating development into tuna-os/gtk-office-suite -- their original standalone repos are archived and can't take new issues).
